verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a charged Runic Blade or get caught without E up when she leads Q3 or W; you win if you dodge her stun with Counter Strike and punish the 13s gap after Broken Wings burns out.

brief.thesis: Riven's whole kit is a burst combo on short cooldowns (W 11-7s, E 10-6s, Q 13s) with no sustained damage once it's spent, while Jax's Counter Strike (E) is a defensive stance built to eat exactly that combo — the OP.GG-listed tip is to use it on her basic attacks, third Broken Wings, or Ki Burst. This is why the lane grades even (338 games, 45.9% Jax WR) but with a solo-kill edge to Jax: if you survive her opener, she has nothing left to punish your counter-engage.

theirWindow.when: when she leads with Q3 or Ki Burst
theirWindow.what: This is her only hard CC and gap-close burst. If Counter Strike (E) isn't up to dodge her autos and reduce the AoE hit, you eat a full stun-into-empowered-auto sequence — hold E on cooldown timers of 18/16/14/12/10s and don't walk into range when she's clearly setting up.

yourWindow.when: right after Counter Strike (E) comes off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk her down so she's forced to open with Q or W into you, then pop E to dodge her basic attacks and stun her back — this is the literal counterplay OP.GG calls out, and it converts directly into your solo-kill edge in this matchup.

start.why: Highest pick rate at 48.2% (44.8% WR over 210 games) — the extra AD and sustain matter more than Doran's Shield's damage reduction since Riven's threat is a burst window, not chip poke.

boots.why: Run in 76.5% of games (46.1% WR over 319 games) because Riven's entire damage kit is physical basic attacks and Runic Blade-empowered autos — flat armor and reduced auto damage directly counters her all-in.

core.why: The proc pairs with Empower (W) for the exact trade window you're fighting for; this is the most-run first item (17.5% pick in the Trinity → Sundered Sky → Zhonya's line).
On-hit healing and a bonus proc extend skirmishes past her burst window, punishing her for engaging into an already-dodged combo.
Answers her level 6/11/16 Blade of the Exile all-in and Wind Slash — the one burst source that ignores your E timing if you're already engaged.

situational.when: she's committing hard to every all-in and you need post-mitigation healing to win the extended trade
you're already ahead in the solo-kill exchanges and want the shield to survive her follow-up after your Counter Strike stun
the game runs long and you need consistent on-hit pressure instead of a third burst item

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards standing in extended trades exactly when Riven's burst is spent — it pairs directly with Empower (W) autos and stacks further once Relentless Assault (R) is up in a fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best measured result (54% WR, 26.8% pick) — Teleport lets you reset side-lane pressure in an even matchup instead of forcing every skirmish. Flash+Ignite is the most-picked combo (56.5% pick) if you'd rather lean on your solo-kill edge to just close out lane kills.

playing.title: Save E for her opener, not yours
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all basic attacks and reduces AoE damage — hold it until she commits Q3 or Ki Burst rather than using it to initiate.

playing.title: Watch her blade glow before trading
playing.detail: Runic Blade charges her next auto for bonus damage after she uses an ability; don't walk into a trade the moment she's cast Q or W.

playing.title: Punish the 13s Broken Wings gap
playing.detail: Once she's burned her full Q combo, she has no mobility or engage for 13 seconds — that's your window to Leap Strike in with Empower up.

playing.title: Respect her ultimate range window
playing.detail: From level 6, Blade of the Exile gives her bonus AD and range plus one Wind Slash — don't sit at low HP within her extended auto range during that window.

playing.title: Trade with autos before Leap Strike ranks up
playing.detail: The measured build maxes W (Empower) first and E second, leaving Q at rank 1 for a long stretch — lean on empowered auto trades early rather than all-inning off Leap Strike.

playing.title: Zhonya's answers her all-in, not your poke
playing.detail: Save the active for when she's already committed Q, W, and R together — it's a burst-survival tool, not a proactive engage item.

playing.title: Shove with Empower before she resets
playing.detail: Since the lane is even overall, use empowered autos to push waves fast and force trades on your terms instead of absorbing her first engage for free.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune pages, boots, and summoner numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade timing, cooldown reads, and power-curve calls are this brief's own tactical analysis.
